purpose: Cross-topic stability and Style 7 versus Style 8 discrimination without copying golden example content.

request.objective: Show focused work as one open page kept calm beneath a simple umbrella while a few interruption droplets remain outside the protected area.

confirmed: Reducing simultaneous interruptions can protect a period of focused work.
The umbrella and page form an approachable metaphor rather than a literal productivity mechanism.
simplifications: Use one small open page beneath one gently tilted umbrella as the complete central metaphor.
Use only a few muted blue interruption droplets outside the umbrella and one restrained ochre bookmark on the protected page.
blocked: Do not imply guaranteed productivity, an optimal interruption count, or a universal focus method.
Do not copy the golden cover loom, thread, woven ribbon, transformation topology, or object positions.

composition.structure: one complete low-density warm-paper teaching picture with an umbrella sheltering an open page, occupying roughly seventy percent with a quiet title-safe band
composition.hierarchy: fine graphite-brown contours define the two familiar objects; translucent dusty blue carries interruptions, sage supports the protected area, and one ochre bookmark provides emphasis

text_policy.mode: text-free background with deterministic title overlay

one complete approachable physical metaphor, consistent object proportions, low density, and generous margins

The result remains a quiet watercolor teaching sketch rather than a dense annotated systems whiteboard.

request.objective: Explain one relation: a provisional route marker may move when one new piece of evidence changes which path is better supported.

confirmed: A conclusion may be revised when relevant new evidence changes what is supported.
Revision is represented as a gentle spatial relation and does not claim that every new input should change the conclusion.
simplifications: Use one shallow forked track, one small movable marker, and one distinct ochre evidence token near the newly supported branch.
Use muted blue and sage washes to distinguish the provisional and revised branches without labels or arrows.
blocked: Do not invent confidence scores, probability values, evidence weights, or a guarantee of correctness.
Do not copy the golden concept tray, inclusion boundary, three-inside-one-outside count, or object arrangement.

composition.structure: one gentle low-density relation built from a forked wooden track, one marker, and one evidence token on fully opaque warm paper
composition.hierarchy: fine contour makes the fork and marker readable; translucent muted washes distinguish the paths; the restrained ochre token is the only strong emphasis

text_policy.mode: label-free objects with deterministic captions added later

platform.name: wechat
platform.occupancy: the complete fork-marker-evidence relation occupies roughly sixty-eight percent with open silhouettes and balanced margins
platform.crop_rules: both branches, the marker, and the evidence token remain in the central safe region

must_preserve: one gentle causal relation through one to three familiar object families, fine contour, translucent watercolor restraint, and consistent shallow perspective
quiet low-density spatial explanation with fully opaque warm paper and generous margins
acceptance_checks: The possibility of revision is understandable without numerical or textual claims.
No tray containment story, dense annotation, black label tab, or corporate card grid appears.

request.objective: Render a human-free five-node publication flow in which a draft combines with source notes, passes through review, then reaches publication, while a failed review returns only to the draft.

confirmed: Draft and source notes both enter review.
A passed review leads to publication.
A failed review returns to the draft for revision.
simplifications: Show exactly five nodes using open captions and a calm two-group arrangement.
Use one restrained ochre review node and one dashed muted return edge for revision.
blocked: Do not add authors, editors, tools, scores, approval authorities, archives, distribution systems, or undeclared nodes and edges.
Do not copy the golden diagram learning nodes, three-to-one convergence story, labels, or topology.

invariants: Publication is reachable only through review.
A failed review returns to draft through revision-needed and never directly to publication.

composition.structure: strict human-free front-orthogonal warm-paper diagram with two preparation nodes at left, review at center, publication at right, and revision-needed below center
composition.hierarchy: fine graphite-brown primary edges carry the exact graph; a muted dashed return distinguishes revision; translucent blue and sage groups remain open and one ochre wash emphasizes review
composition.human_elements: none; no people, faces, hands, characters, instructors, narrators, mascots, or stock imagery
